outcome: National Cholesterol Education Program Adult Treatment Panel III criteria for metabolic syndrome (NCE-ATP III)
cohort: Women who delivered at Dr. Soetomo Academic Hospital in 2013, with a diagnosis of preeclampsia (preterm or term) or a normal pregnancy, were included in the study.
finding: A history of preeclampsia (preterm or term) increased the risk of hypertension and cardiovascular disease, and showed a tendency toward an increased risk of metabolic syndrome five years after delivery.
